sources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: original game battle animation sheet.
Image 1 is the edit target: the original Stag-Knot Runner 4-column by 3-row sheet with clean alpha. Image 2 is a supporting reference ONLY for the front-knee-buckling death pose in bottom row column2.
Primary request: return the SAME TWELVE poses in the SAME 4x3 layout, but make EVERY whole stag face screen RIGHT instead of LEFT. Preserve each original action, body scale, four connected root legs, paired branch antlers, pale birch bark, dark green root muscles, red vine bindings, small empty saddle, amber oval chest gem, long trailing root tail and tan ribbons. No rider. Do not merely rotate heads; the whole anatomical body must face right. Keep each pose within its own original cell, no reordering or overlapping neighbors.
Change bottom row column2 to the corrected death buckle from Image2: both front knees bend deeply to ground and chest/head drop, rear hips remain raised, all four feet visible. Bottom row column3 is side fall; bottom row column4 is fully prone settled corpse. In all three bottom-row death cells columns2-4, eye and chest gem are completely unlit dark brown amber; final corpse has a closed dark eyelid, no bright eye dot or emitted light. Keep equipment and antlers throughout.
Other pose actions unchanged: idle, alert breath, extended gallop, gathered gallop, diagonal contact, crouched anticipation, low antler ram, defensive brace, hit recoil.
Background: flat pure MAGENTA RGB255,0,255 in every empty space and aperture, no checkerboard, gradient, ground, shadow or reflected magenta. Preserve original warm muted painterly texture and constant anatomical scale. Full entire 4x3 sheet with generous margins around antlers, toes, tail and corpse; no text, grid lines, extra limbs, detached roots, spell effects or glow clouds. Original game art, no copyrighted characters.
sources.review: Required right-facing precursor, not packed: local magenta extraction retained visible pink edge spill. The separate built-in extraction is selected after actual-alpha compositing.

sources.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Image1 is the exact original 12-pose Stag-Knot Runner 4x3 sprite sheet to extract. Remove ONLY the pure magenta background and its pink edge spill, replacing every outside pixel and enclosed empty aperture with genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve all twelve right-facing character paintings, exact positions, pale birch bark, brown root antlers and feet, red bindings, saddle, tan ribbons, tail and amber gems. Magenta/pink is NOT a character material: remove pink contamination from thin antler/root outlines while retaining original brown wood and red bindings. Do not repaint or redesign bodies, alter poses, change eyes/gems or add/drop branches. Keep dark dead-eye/gem states in bottom row columns2-4. All extremities stay complete inside canvas. Output actual RGBA transparency, not a painted checker pattern, green backdrop, brown backdrop, floor, shadow or glow. Same canvas and sprite scale; no text or grid.
sources.review: Genuine RGBA0..254, clean on green. Eleven selected cells including dark-eye/gem deaths. Generative extraction changes detail/contrast, so these are not unchanged original-draft pixels.
